tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Intel OT-ST7220 25GbE Dual Port SFP+ Ethernet Network Card is a high-performance network adapter designed for modern data centers, servers, and high-speed networking applications. Powered by the Intel XXV710-DA2 chipset, this dual-port NIC delivers ultra-fast 10G/25G Ethernet connectivity over SFP28 interfaces, perfectly suited for virtualization, storage, and cloud-based systems.

With a PCIe 3.0 x8 interface, the OT-ST7220 ensures maximum throughput and low latency for demanding workloads. Whether you need faster server communication, improved data transfer rates, or scalable network performance, this network card delivers reliable and efficient network acceleration.


Key Features

  • Dual 25GbE SFP28 ports (backward compatible with 10G SFP+)
  • Intel XXV710-DA2 Ethernet controller
  • Supports 10G/25G network speeds
  • PCIe 3.0 x8 interface for high throughput
  • Ideal for servers, virtualization, and high-speed networking
  • Advanced offload and acceleration features
  • Compatible with major OS: Linux, Windows Server
